goal: Project meaningful same-run ROS business events into the existing read-only web event list without changing the active simulator
acceptance: Use an explicit optional --events-source for the existing read-only live/replay primary; no command capability, outbox, CPU-model mutation or automatic unrelated file discovery. Preserve behavior when absent. Root alone restarts the owned API after acceptance; active018 immutable source and SDK/WSL remain untouched.

Bound JSONL reading and retained event count; tolerate an in-progress final partial line without inventing data, stable event identity from run+original event_seq, prevent duplicate display and exclude foreign run/malformed/non-finite rows. Do not scan an unbounded file every snapshot. No SQLite connection/copy or ROS commands.

Display only supported original handoff_commit, empty_handoff_commit, empty_trip_dispatched, virtual charger arrival/release/state milestones and order completion events; no per-tick scan/route spam. Classify pickup vs drop and inbound/outbound/empty from original intent/accepted receipt, never imply contact/lifting/electric charge. Material consumption is not currently an actions journal event: only include if a matching original source event exists; never synthesize it from stock differences.

Keep original source timestamps and distinguish the journal ROS clock from dashboard mission elapsed time; do not silently offset/shift timestamps or widen freshness. Events never refresh primary observed_at/connection/revision or change robot pose/speed/battery/scan counters. Join unavailable/mismatch must be explicit in projection provenance without falsely reviving the primary.

Reuse the existing event contract/renderer. Inspect the real TS event fields first. If a small UI clock-label change is required, report its exact file before editing outside the write paths. No new dependencies, broad refactor, SDK runs, new agents, new instances, commit/push or unowned dashboard files.

One focused CPU test pass for the new behavior, not the full suite: optional disabled path, partial tail, foreign run/duplicate/malformed data, read limit, preserved primary staleness and original event time. Return hashes, test command/exit and limitations in result receipt. Root performs one bounded source/evidence review; no repeated review loop.
